decision_conditions: Any damage caused to the building in execution of the works shall be made good to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority within 3 months of the works being completed.
REASON

To safeguard the special architectural and/or historic interest of the building in accordance with Policies DMHB 1 and DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020), Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and Section 16 of the NPPF (2024).

A. On opening up historic ceilings and/or re-roofing, the condition of the roof structure shall be assessed. Should repairs to the roof structure be thought necessary then works shall be halted in the relevant area and the local authority be notified immediately. Any repairs/ replacement works shall be submitted and agreed in writing with the local authority prior to the works re-commencing. Works shall thereafter be undertaken as per the agreement.

B. If during works hidden historic features are revealed they shall be retained in-situ. Works shall be halted to the relevant area of the site and/ or building and the Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately. Failure to do so may result in unauthorised works being carried out and an offence being committed.
REASON

To safeguard the special architectural and/or historic interest of the building in accordance with Policies DMHB 1 and DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020), Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and

The access arrangements to the building entrances approved under discharge of conditions application 4058/APP/2025/997 shall be implemented and permanently retained in accordance with the approved plans.
REASON
To ensure an Accessible and Inclusive development for everyone in accordance with London Plan Policy D5.

All servicing / mechanical & engineering elements for the building shall be constructed in full in accordance with the details approved under discharge of conditions reference 4058/APP/2025/1748 and be retained as such thereafter.
REASON

To safeguard the special architectural and/or historic interest of the building in accordance with Policies DMHB 1 and DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 - Development Management Policies (January 2020).

The decision to GRANT listed building consent has been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

The decision to GRANT listed building consent has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan (2021) and NPPF (2024).

The development is expected to be carried out in accordance with the non-licenced method statement (NLMS) as described in the Hillingdon Hospital Bat Emergence Survey Report (Aecom, February 2024). If, on application of the stages set out in the NLMS, bats are discovered within the building or might be considered to be harmed by the works, the Applicant should engage Natural England immediately and determine the need for a full bat mitigation licence (or alternative as necessary).
description: Variation of Condition 3 (Approved Plans) of Listed Building Consent ref. 4058/APP/2024/3315 dated 13-02-2025 for 'Variation of Condition 3 (Approved Plans) of Listed Building Consent ref. 4058/APP/2024/589, dated 20-06-2024 (External air conditioning plant within a timber enclosure, replacement of external ramp, repair and restoration of windows throughout and installation of secondary glazing, replacement of damaged windows and doors, repairs and application of render and external vents, removal of non-original roof light and infill of roof opening.
